purpose: Collect a support or enquiry message with optional low-risk document attachment.

conditional_logic.rule: show only for request types that genuinely need evidence

confirmations.name: Default confirmation
confirmations.message: Thanks. We have received your request and will review the document if it was attached.

notifications.name: Admin notification
notifications.attachments: Do not attach files by default; link/review in entry if secure.

spam_settings.upload_abuse_review: monitor rejected uploads and spam entries

accessibility_settings.file_help_text: state accepted file types and max size
accessibility_settings.errors: explain file type and size failures

embedding_target: Secure support/contact page using Gravity Forms block
data_retention_notes: Confirm upload retention and deletion policy before launch. Do not collect identity documents unless secure handling is approved. Consent record and wording must be reviewed for retention, export, and erase handling.
risks: File uploads are high-risk and require explicit extension, size, storage, notification, and retention approval
